home.title: Home
home.intro: An educational catalog of the Bolivian vertebrate species facing extinction risk: who they are, where they live and what threatens them.
home.statsIntro: Species listed in FaunBol by their IUCN Red List category.
home.featuredIntro: Species facing the highest risk of disappearing.
home.featuredEmpty: There are no featured species to show yet.
home.exploreText: From the high Andean puna to the Amazon forests, Bolivia is home to 12 ecoregions. Discover which threatened species live in each one.
home.aboutText: Learn what the threat categories mean and where the data comes from.

animal.nationalExplain: Assessment of the extinction risk within Bolivian territory, according to the Red Book of the Wild Vertebrate Fauna of Bolivia.
animal.notAssessedExplain: The species does not have a recorded national assessment yet.

ecoregions.title: Ecoregions
ecoregions.intro: Bolivia is one of the most ecosystem-diverse countries in the world. According to Ibisch & Mérida (2003), its territory is divided into 12 ecoregions.
ecoregions.emptyText: No ecoregions have been recorded yet.

about.title: About
about.lead: FaunBol is an educational, bilingual catalog of Bolivia's threatened wildlife, built as a university project for the Web Technologies 2 course.
about.purposeText: It gathers public information about Bolivian vertebrate species at risk: their global and national conservation status, habitat, threats and the ecoregions where they live. The goal is to bring this knowledge closer to students and the general public.
about.categoriesIntro: The IUCN classifies species into eight categories according to their extinction risk. The three "threatened" categories are CR, EN and VU.
about.noticeText: FaunBol is a strictly educational project. It must not be used to hunt, capture or trade wildlife. Locations are intentionally general (departments and ecoregions), never exact, so as not to put species at risk.
about.legalNote: Hunting, capturing and trafficking wildlife are crimes in Bolivia.

iucnDesc.EX: There is no reasonable doubt that the last individual has died.
iucnDesc.EW: Survives only in captivity or in populations outside its historic range.
iucnDesc.CR: Faces an extremely high risk of extinction in the wild.
iucnDesc.EN: Faces a very high risk of extinction in the wild.
iucnDesc.VU: Faces a high risk of extinction in the wild.
iucnDesc.NT: Is close to qualifying as threatened in the near future.
iucnDesc.LC: Is widespread and abundant; does not qualify as threatened.
iucnDesc.DD: There is not enough information to assess its extinction risk.
